supersedes: pendulum_energy_v2.json (kept; idealised analytic result). v1-v2 used an idealised bob and analytic period; v3 is the GAUGE task: GAUGE geometry, real trajectories, and the paper's PD/EL definitions at 180 Hz, scored at 30 Hz.

data.source: GAUGE public pendulum trajectories (20 JSON, 30 fps, mm)
data.split: selection = odd trial IDs, held-out = even; each trial starts from its own measured release angle (~90 deg)
data.real_reference: real PD (raw FFT, same code) mean 1.118 s; finer zero-padded PD 1.168 +- 0.004 s (paper Table 3: 1.14 +- 0.066 s, consistent with raw 0.1-Hz FFT bins 1.111 / 1.25 s)

fixed.scene: GAUGE pendulum: 0.3175 kg ball (radius 30 mm, solid-sphere inertia) 0.278 m below an undamped world-y hinge at (0.37396, 0.49059, 0.445133) m; massless rod; no contact
fixed.release: from rest at the trial's measured angle; perturbation U(+-3 mrad); identical arrays for both engines
fixed.sampling: states every 1/30 s; 3000 frames (PD uses the first 300)
fixed.pass_gate: finite state and a detectable final swing peak in every rollout
fixed.loss: mean |PD_sim / PD_real(trial) - 1| + |EL|; PD = 1 / dominant raw-FFT frequency of the 300-frame x trajectory (paper); EL = (E_start - E_end) / E_start from peak potential energy over 3000 frames (paper eq. 17; target 0, the paper's undamped ideal)
fixed.mechanism_metrics: zero-padded PD (finer than the paper's 0.1-Hz bins), minimum EL (energy gain if < 0), 300-frame 3D RMSE vs the real trial

selection_rule: pass gate, then loss, then wall time
seed_rule: selection: seed0; held-out cell j: seed0 + 1000 + j

candidate_rule.rationale: contact-free hinge: SAP's only native option that changes these dynamics is solver precision; MuJoCo's are the integrators. No padding with duplicates.

held_out_conditions.axis: mass (period is mass-independent; real reference exact)
mass (period is mass-independent; real reference exact)

not_run_conditions.reason: single GAUGE configuration; no real reference
